description: A stereo three-band splitter with an envelope follower on each band: two crossover points cut the signal into low, mid and high, each with its own level and stereo pair

params.text: Sets the frequency the two crossover points are placed around, -2V to 4V against 261.63Hz at 0V
Attenuverts the centre CV before it is added to the centre knob
Sets how far apart the two crossover points are placed, half an octave either side of the centre at one end of the travel and three octaves either side at the other
Attenuverts the spread CV before it is added to the spread knob
Opens or closes a gap between each crossover's low-pass and high-pass corner, up to two octaves either way, so the bands overlap or leave a hole between them
Attenuverts the gap CV before it is added to the gap knob
Sets how steep the crossover slopes are, with most of the change packed into the last quarter of the travel
Attenuverts the sharpness CV before it is added to the sharpness knob
Adds resonance at the crossover corners by feeding each band back on itself, with most of the change packed into the top of the travel
Attenuverts the resonance CV before it is added to the resonance knob
Drives the bands into saturation before they are summed and sent out
Attenuverts the drive CV before it is added to the drive knob
Sets the level of the low band's pair of outputs, silence to full
Attenuverts the low level CV before it is added to the low level slider
Sets the level of the mid band's pair of outputs, silence to full
Attenuverts the mid level CV before it is added to the mid level slider
Sets the level of the high band's pair of outputs, silence to full
Attenuverts the high level CV before it is added to the high level slider
Sets the level of the summed pair of outputs, silence to full
Attenuverts the mix level CV before it is added to the mix level slider
Pushes the filter settings of the left and right sides in opposite directions, -1 to 1, on whichever controls have their map button lit
Attenuverts the width CV before it is added to the width knob
Switches whether the width control pushes the left and right centre frequencies apart
Switches whether the width control pushes the left and right spreads apart
Switches whether the width control pushes the left and right gaps apart
Switches whether the width control pushes the left and right sharpness settings apart
Switches whether the width control pushes the left and right resonance settings apart
Switches whether the width control pushes the left and right drive settings apart

inputs.text: The left signal into the filter
The right signal into the filter; with nothing patched it carries the left signal
Moves the centre frequency a volt per octave, added to the centre knob without passing through a trimmer
Moves the centre frequency, added to the centre knob through its trimmer
Changes the spread, scaled by a tenth and added to the spread knob through its trimmer, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the gap, scaled by a fifth and added to the gap knob through its trimmer, the total clamped to two octaves either way
Changes the slope steepness, scaled by a tenth and added to the sharpness knob through its trimmer, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the resonance, scaled by a tenth and added to the resonance knob through its trimmer, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the drive, scaled by a tenth and added to the drive knob through its trimmer, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the low band's level, added to the low slider through its trimmer, the total clamped to the slider's travel
Changes the mid band's level, added to the mid slider through its trimmer, the total clamped to the slider's travel
Changes the high band's level, added to the high slider through its trimmer, the total clamped to the slider's travel
Changes the summed output's level, added to the mix slider through its trimmer, the total clamped to the slider's travel
Changes the stereo width offset, scaled by a tenth and added to the width knob through its trimmer, the total clamped to -1 to 1

outputs.text: The left side of that band, scaled by that band's level and clamped to -10 to 10V
The right side of that band, scaled by that band's level and clamped to -10 to 10V
Follows the amplitude of that band, rising and falling over the time set by the Follow Time slider on the menu
The left side of all three bands summed, driven and scaled by the mix level, clamped to -10 to 10V
The right side of all three bands summed, driven and scaled by the mix level, clamped to -10 to 10V
Follows the amplitude of the summed signal, rising and falling over the time set by the Follow Time slider on the menu

notes: the centre frequency tracks a volt per octave at the V/OCT jack, so a keyboard patched there moves the whole filter with the note
three envelope outputs are declared without a panel jack, the inverted companions of the three band followers, so only the upright envelopes can be patched
menu: Follow Time — a slider from 0 to 1 setting how quickly the four envelope outputs follow the signal
Internal Feedback — turns the resonance feedback path on, which is what lets the resonance control ring at the crossover corners
Scaled Envelopes — multiplies each envelope output by its band's level control, so an envelope falls silent when its band is turned down
